title: 🔥 Struggled with AI Poses? We’re Sharing Our Solution! (FREE for Game Devs!)
author: enemyzone
selftext:
Hey fellow creators! 👋

We’re Meteoric Desires, and we’re hustling to build our FIRST visual novel using AI! 🎮✨

But wow—this journey had its tough moments...



💥 The Struggle is REAL:

OpenPose files took DAYS to perfect (so many failed attempts! 😅)

We hit walls with AI consistency, pose control, and workflow chaos...

But we pushed through and built a system that actually works!



🎁 Why We’re Giving Away 12 OpenPose Files:

"We struggled so YOU don’t have to."

These poses helped us create fluid character animations—now they’re FREE for YOU!



🚀 How to Get Them (SUPER Easy!):

Join our Patreon → FREE MEMBERSHIP LINK

(No payment needed! Just support our journey!)

Download instantly from our "Free Assets" post!



🌟 Why Your Support Matters:

You’re not just downloading files—you’re joining our dev journey!

Every free member fuels our motivation to keep creating.

We share uncensored guides, tools, and BTS as we grow!

"Your support (even free!) means the world to us. Let’s build amazing things together!" ❤️



💬 Let’s Connect!

Using our poses? Show us! We’d love to see your art! 🎨

Questions? Ask below—we’re here to help!

Game dev struggles? Let’s vent & solve together! 😤➡️😄

Join FREE & Grab Your Poses → [https://www.patreon.com/posts/135622203](https://www.patreon.com/posts/135622203)

No tricks. No paywall. Just love for the dev community. 💪
